services.title: Pediatric Preventive Dental Care
services.description: Gentle oral examinations, cavity prevention fluoride varnishes, and dental sealants designed to protect developing enamel in growing children.
services.idealFor: First dental visits, toddler oral health, routine preventive care

services.title: Gentle Milk Tooth Pulp Therapy
services.description: Compassionate nerve-saving treatments for deeply decayed baby teeth to eliminate pain, stop infection, and guide adult tooth eruption naturally.
services.idealFor: Severe tooth pain, deep cavities in baby teeth

services.title: Pediatric Zirconia & Stainless Crowns
services.description: Pre-formed natural white zirconia and stainless steel crowns to restore heavily damaged baby molars and ensure durable chewing strength.
services.idealFor: Post-pulp therapy molars, fractured baby teeth

services.title: Special Healthcare Needs Dentistry
services.description: Tailored dental care for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and sensory sensitivities, featuring unhurried pacing and ambient calming care.
services.idealFor: Sensory sensitive children, medically fragile pediatric patients

services.title: Preventive Orthodontics & Space Maintainers
services.description: Custom dental space maintainers and early intervention devices to hold space open for permanent teeth after premature baby tooth loss.
services.idealFor: Premature tooth loss, finger-sucking habit correction

services.title: Comfort-Focused Sedation Dentistry
services.description: Safe, regulated conscious sedation care for fearful children requiring extensive treatment, monitored with hospital-grade equipment.
services.idealFor: Extremely anxious young patients, multi-tooth treatments
